reason: Both conversations correctly dismissed 'SA2' as an error code, sensibly asked whether the fan spins, and ended by escalating to an engineer without asking for the full model from the rating plate or offering the power-off hand-turn check and competent-DIY motor swap the homeowner was willing to do. Conversation 2 edges ahead because its second turn gives a clean, correct diagnosis (seized fan motor consistent with the earlier grinding/squeal) and explicitly tells the homeowner to isolate the power at the mains, whereas Conversation 1 muddies the diagnosis with an unsupported 'shorted heating element tripping the cutout' theory and gives no isolation instruction. Conversation 1 was marginally firmer on 'SA2' being the model series, but that does not outweigh Conversation 2's clearer diagnosis and safety step.
